notes.title: Demo version output
notes.content:
[h3]It was a very long development of the demo version of the game, and we had to postpone the update date for a couple of weeks due to minor improvements, but now we are ready to present the game to you.

[h2] What's new?[/h2] [list]
[*] Added mini-games: snake and Flappy Bird
[*] Added interactive moments
[*] Added achievements and highscore table for mini-games
[/list][h2] What has changed?[/h2][list]
[*] The plot of the 2022 game has been completely rewritten
[*] Completely updated graphics and music
[*] Completely updated the game menu
[*] Rewritten the work with modifications and the tools in general
[/list][/h3]

[h2]End[/h2]
[h3]Thank you to everyone who continued to believe in us and helped us develop the demo version! We are very excited to finally release the update, but that doesn't mean we won't continue working. Now we are going on a short break and a PR campaign, so we will publish less news and posts in our [url=https://discord.gg/RNzGSkGhqz]Discord[/url], [url=https://vk.com/crucialexperim]VK[/url], [url=https://t.me/CrucialExperiment] Telegram[/url] and [url=https://boosty.to/crucialexperiment]Boosty[/url]. If you want to help us with the development, you can send a donation to [url=https://boosty.to/crucialexperiment]Boosty[/url], [url=https://www.donationalerts.com/r/crucialexperiment]DonationAlerts[/url] or write to us in the social network in the help offer.

We would also appreciate it if you subscribe to the game and recommend it to your friends (or purchase another copy of the game on other platforms, or subscribe to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/dev/crucialexperiment/]Crucial Experiment page[/url] on Steam).[/h3]

notes.title: DevBlog #4 - Content
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello, did you expect to see us again? Yes, this is us, Crucial Experiment, alive and with a new devblog.[/b][/h3]

[h3]What can we tell you about the development of the game at the moment? We are already finishing the 3rd scene, which together with itself will bring the first full-fledged alpha version of the game with the first main piece of the plot!

We would like to say right away that the release of the pre-demo version is scheduled for April 24-25, 2024. The full list of changes will appear with the update.[/h3]

[h2]Design[/h2]
[h3]The first thing I would like to show is the new game footage that we published in our [url=https://vk.com/crucialexperim]VK[/url], [url=https://t.me/CrucialExperiment]Telegram[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/RNzGSkGhqz]Discord[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40701240/4b8c1f29bcf5114e576c24e19df8f2ce7ec7af67.png[/img]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40701240/7a953ca2d048f17ce8704ace0de458b26306d7ea.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40701240/40d98f7924b16cb37234b1e612e9d9f94b5b1980.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40701240/22876aa341b57605636ba0cc451a98f0f73c3aa4.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40701240/046695e6f57d3f4220bdba6453ffd54235eedf8d.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40701240/520992c7fa60a4b5762c2bdc768163a0b28a75d6.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40701240/e96694ec15b2b0c2c44c67e340f8de844f6fbb23.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40701240/428fcdf258fe1d9908c8200c11d4cf42ad5fef2a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40701240/a04d22630ccb79ff1c56f8560c3c98a55602c2f8.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40701240/7b82ee560fb4a2b254ced40468d57033f65fe79c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40701240/89583b792db4dd0b6e597a21955bbadff1a32ec7.png[/img][/url]

This is not quite the final version yet, but it is closer to the final one, and we, of course, continue to improve the graphics, as well as the plot itself.[/h3]

[h2]Scenario[/h2]
[h3] The game script has been slightly rewritten in a couple of months since the last devblog to simplify it in the future. For example, the dialogues at the very beginning of the train were changed, adding some information there. It was also decided to introduce some interactive parts, which will also be added over time, and possibly change a little.

The development time of one scene has been increased, but we are trying to tell the story in more detail in it. Starting from the 4th scene in the game, the plot itself will begin, where more topics will be revealed.[/h3]

[h2]Soundtrack[/h2]
[h3]The musical score has been slightly changed and new tracks have been added. The soundtrack has been updated and new sounds have been added.[/h3]

[h2]Modification Tool (under development)[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40701240/81ed107b7ae809adab878d947012eba26ae4f90b.png[/img]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40701240/f7bc3af1eec391a08217a2ae8c6a308f80b08469.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40701240/cfebb1d0c652f96ea6824378eb9284444ae776f7.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40701240/c001063f3e980090480c18a1091f34966c533221.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40701240/985776786f0b68250c63c97beb70ae327b179ce4.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Is a completely new program that supports the ability to create simple scenarios using visual editing through the event tree. You can not only create your own plots, but also skins and modes for mini-games. The program is currently under active development and a completely new design is already being prepared.[/h3]

[h2]End[/h2]
[h3]Thank you to everyone who continues to wait and believe in us! We are very happy to continue working on improving the game. Don't forget that we will continue to work no matter what. If you want to help us with the development, you can send a donation to [url=https://boosty.to/crucialexperiment]Boosty[/url] or to [url=https://www.donationalerts.com/r/crucialexperiment]DonationAlerts[/url] or write to us on social medianetworks in offering help.

We would also appreciate it if you add the game to your wish list and recommend it to your friends (or subscribe to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/dev/crucialexperiment/]Crucial Experiment[/url] page on Steam).

That's all for now, new concepts and some other news can be found in our [url=https://vk.com/crucialexperim]VK[/url], [url=https://t.me/CrucialExperiment]Telegram[/url] или [url=https://discord.gg/RNzGSkGhqz]Discord[/url].[/h3]
